_comment: The Gate 2 pass definition, fixed before the analyser ships. T33 Part B criterion 4.
A gate settled after seeing output is not a gate, so this file is read by
t33-acceptance.sh rather than assembled from what a run produced.
Sources: ETSI TR 101 290 for the P1/P2 sub-error numbering and limits. The
analyser-specific block is NOT TR 101 290 -- PLL lock and the T-STD buffer model are
vendor verdicts, and they are listed separately so nobody quotes them as conformance.
'measurable_in_software' marks what the Part B rehearsal against the software reference
can actually grade. Everything false there is a hardware-day first, which is exactly the
list this file exists to make visible in advance.
domain: wire (P2 at the analyser input); the software rehearsal is file-domain P1 only

p1.name: TS_sync_loss
p1.limit: no loss of synchronisation; 2 consecutive correct sync bytes to regain

p1.name: PAT_error
p1.limit: PID 0x0000 absent > 0.5 s; table_id != 0x00 on PID 0x0000; scrambling_control != 00

p1.name: Continuity_count_error
p1.limit: incorrect packet order, lost packet, or duplicate beyond the one ISO 13818-1 2.4.3.3 permits

p1.name: PMT_error
p1.limit: PMT section absent > 0.5 s on any PID referenced by the PAT; table_id != 0x02

p1.name: PID_error
p1.limit: a PID referenced in the PMT carries no data for the user-defined period

p2.name: CRC_error
p2.limit: CRC failure in any PAT, PMT, CAT, NIT, EIT, BAT, SDT or TOT table section

p2.name: PCR_error
p2.limit: PCR discontinuity > 100 ms without discontinuity_indicator; PCR repetition > 40 ms

p2.name: PCR_repetition_error
p2.limit: interval between consecutive PCR values > 40 ms

p2.name: PCR_discontinuity_indicator_error
p2.limit: PCR difference > 100 ms with the indicator not set

p2.name: PCR_accuracy_error
p2.note: Graded in software only as a file-domain value check (tsp pcrverify --absolute --jitter-max 13, 481 ns). Release timing is a wire property and needs the analyser.

p2.name: PTS_error
p2.limit: PTS repetition > 700 ms except in trick modes

p2.name: CAT_error
p2.limit: scrambled packets present with no CAT; table_id != 0x01 on PID 0x0001
p2.note: Not exercised: nothing in the campaign scrambles.

analyser_specific.name: PLL lock state
analyser_specific.limit: locked for the whole soak; every unlock event timestamped and counted
analyser_specific.note: Not TR 101 290. This is the receiver's own clock recovery and is the single thing the software reference cannot stand in for.

analyser_specific.name: T-STD buffer model verdict
analyser_specific.limit: no transport, multiplex or elementary buffer overflow or underflow across the soak
analyser_specific.note: Not TR 101 290. Vendor-specific model; record the vendor and model version alongside the verdict.

analyser_specific.name: Service presence and decode
analyser_specific.limit: service decodes continuously; every loss-of-service event timestamped

analyser_specific.name: Input bitrate stability
analyser_specific.limit: measured mux rate within the analyser's CBR tolerance for the whole soak

capture.requirement: exactly one machine-readable export path, logged to file, chosen before the analyser ships
capture.note: Confirm the export path on the specific model before it ships. This cannot be worked around on site.

run_order.soak_rationale: The PCR base wraps every 26.51 h, so a soak under 72 h may not cross one. Part A crosses it by placement instead, which is cheaper but is a file-domain result.
